notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.content: [h1]Change log 1.05[/h1][p]- [b]\[Experimental][/b] You can now hit X to fast forward to the end of a line of dialogue.[/p][p]- Rescaled maps and enemies to make hacking easier.[/p][p]- Fixed bug where 4 missiles in a square would brick the game.[/p][p]- Lowered the unlock price of the missile and splitter (so hard players can try them out).[/p][p]- Fixed bug with exiting and starting a new save, resulting in some events not playing.[/p][p]- Now asks you to confirm before overwriting your save.[/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: - [b][Experimental][/b] You can now hit X to fast forward to the end of a line of dialogue.

tags.balance_change: - Rescaled maps and enemies to make hacking easier.

tags.bug: - Fixed bug where 4 missiles in a square would brick the game.

tags.balance_change: - Lowered the unlock price of the missile and splitter (so hard players can try them out).

tags.bug: - Fixed bug with exiting and starting a new save, resulting in some events not playing.

tags.feature: - Now asks you to confirm before overwriting your save.
